subject: Handoff & MAP: Prospect Labs eval dataset, prompt pack, and delivery schedule
messages:
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@prospect-labs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@prospect-labs.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Handoff & MAP: Prospect Labs eval dataset, prompt pack, and delivery schedule

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the intake and for drafting the MAP. Carlos and I reviewed the milestones and we'd like to proceed but we need to confirm a couple of constraints before you ship the prompt pack and dataset: 

- Usage scope: The data and prompt examples will be used strictly for evaluation within Prospect Labs and our contracted vendors; no public redistribution.
- Retention: We need an assurance that Redwood will delete our dataset copies after 90 days unless we request otherwise.
- Redaction: A small subset of the dataset (PII rows) will be redacted by our side; we'll attach the sanitized sample.

We can sign an NDA if needed; I've attached a countersigned one for speed. Can you confirm Redwood's standard evaluation license and whether you require any additional paperwork? Also, what's the ETA for the prompt pack delivery once we execute the MAP?

Best,
Alyssa
Director of ML Ops
Prospect Labs

Attachments: NDA_ProspectLabs_signed.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@prospect-labs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Handoff & MAP: Prospect Labs eval dataset, prompt pack, and delivery schedule

Hi Alyssa,

Thank you — and great to see the countersigned NDA attached. Quick answers up front: 

- License/usage: We can agree to a limited evaluation license: internal evaluation only, no redistribution, no model training for commercial models without explicit consent. We'll add that clause to the MAP document.
- Retention: 90 days post-delivery is fine; we'll mark automated deletion in the MAP and confirm deletion with a final audit log export.
- Redaction: Perfect — please share the sanitized sample. We'll validate locally to ensure no PII remains in our evaluation store.

ETA: Once MAP and NDA are in place, we can deliver the prompt pack (prompt examples, expected pass/fail tags, and evaluation harness README) within 48 business hours. The sample dataset can be shared the same day via a secure Drive folder; full dataset delivery timing will depend on file size but typically same-day for <5GB.

I'm cc'ing Marissa to coordinate packaging and Rishi for contract language on the MAP.

Next step: Marissa, can you draft the MAP addendum with the license + retention clause and upload the prompt pack to the Drive link below? Rishi, can you flag any redlines we should apply to the MAP before signature?

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference for production

Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cProspectEval
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@prospect-labs.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Handoff & MAP: Prospect Labs eval dataset, prompt pack, and delivery schedule

Ben — looping everyone in with the MAP addendum draft attached. Key items I added based on Alyssa's asks: 

- Section 2.1: Limited Evaluation License (internal evaluation only; no model training; no redistribution).
- Section 3.4: Data Retention & Deletion — automated deletion scheduled at 90 days; customer will receive audit log of deletion.
- Section 4.2: PII Handling — customer to provide redacted sample; Redwood will validate and quarantine any flagged items.
- Section 6.1: Delivery Timeline — prompt pack within 48 business hours after countersigned MAP & NDA; sample dataset link same day; full dataset delivery for files <5GB same day, otherwise staggered on agreement.

I've uploaded the prompt pack and a short evaluation harness README to the secure folder. Links below. The prompt pack contains: prompt_templates.md, expected_outputs.jsonl, testcases_metadata.csv, and a lightweight harness script. 

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cProspectEval
Prompt pack (attachment): prospect_eval_prompt_pack_v1.zip
Sample dataset (attachment): prospect_sample_dataset.csv

Alyssa — please review the MAP addendum and confirm we can proceed to sign-off. If approved, Ben will schedule the handoff and we'll trigger the upload and deletion timers.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@prospect-labs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@prospect-labs.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T16:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Handoff & MAP: Prospect Labs eval dataset, prompt pack, and delivery schedule

Marissa / Ben — looks good from our side. Alyssa and I reviewed the addendum and the license terms match our legal team's expectations. A couple of small items: 

- Can you add a clause that Redwood will not retain verbatim copies of prompts beyond the 90-day window (we'd like derivative artifacts excluded too unless agreed).
- For the audit log, please include a preview export (CSV) showing deletion events and file hashes.

If you can add those two bullets, we can sign the MAP tonight and expect the prompt pack link and sample dataset download immediately after. We appreciate the quick turnaround.

Carlos
Head of Data Engineering
Prospect Labs

Attachment: NDA_ProspectLabs_signed.pdf (from earlier)
